description: This file defines an abstract class 'SugarWebService' which serves as a base for all web services in the SuiteCRM project. It includes abstract methods related to registration and serving web services.

classes.name: SugarWebService
classes.description: Abstract base class for all web services within SuiteCRM, providing method signatures for registration, implementation, and error handling.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Abstract method to register functions with optional exclusions.

methods.name: registerImplClass
methods.description: Abstract method to register an implementation class.

methods.name: getRegisteredImplClass
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the registered implementation class.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Abstract method to register a class.

methods.name: getRegisteredClass
methods.description: Abstract method to get the registered class.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Abstract method to handle the service request.
